name: Complete Crossing and Maximum Classes Are Face-Prime
statement: Every finite irredundant complete-crossing partial cube is gated-prime and hence cubical-face-prime. In particular, every irredundant maximum class of VC dimension at least two is cubical-face-prime.
proof: A proper gated two-cover fixes a nonempty, disjoint coordinate set on each factor. Completeness supplies a square varying one coordinate from each set, and no factor can contain that square. Maximum classes of VC dimension at least two strongly shatter every coordinate pair, so their crossing graph is complete.
